question: 销售金额高于全部分类平均销售金额的叶子分类有哪些？（请给出分类名称与销售额）
gold_sql: WITH cat_sales AS (SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS sales FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY c.id, c.name) SELECT name, ROUND(sales, 2) AS revenue FROM cat_sales WHERE sales > (SELECT AVG(sales) FROM cat_sales) ORDER BY revenue DESC
